name: Fiery Grasp
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur)

EFFECT

Range touch
Target one creature
Duration 1 round/level (D)
Saving Throw Will negates; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

You cause glowing orange flames to burn along your arms. Although you feel no heat, the flickering flames grant you a touch attack that deals 1d6 points of fire damage. Anything you touch with your hands, including your own equipment, suffers this damage.
